en.summary: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu is a first-person cooperative horror game from ACE Team (Zeno Clash, Clash: Artifacts of Chaos), published by Nacon and released July 15, 2026 on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S with full cross-play. Loosely inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's novella The Mound, it casts 1–4 players as Conquistador-era treasure hunters exploring a cursed 16th-century South American jungle in search of a legendary underground city.

guideSections.title: The Sanity System — Your Squad Is the Threat
guideSections.description: The Mound's defining mechanic is a sanity meter that degrades over each expedition and warps each player's perception independently, producing visual and auditory hallucinations. Because corruption is per-player, teammates can become genuinely indistinguishable from monsters — not through hidden-role rules, but because you can no longer trust what you see and hear. Fallen adventurers can also become corrupted and turn on the party.

guideSections.title: Expedition Loop & Proximity Voice
guideSections.description: Runs start aboard your galleon, where the team selects a contract and loads out weapons and equipment before heading into the jungle. Proximity voice chat is central to the design — staying close, moving quietly and conserving resources are the keys to completing contracts and extracting alive. Eight playable characters are planned, with four available at launch.
